newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable before holiday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable before holiday.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday before Wednesday's holiday, and dealers expected stable trade by year-end.
The local dollar ended at T$27.499 against Monday's T$27.500 close. Turnover through dealers was US$179.5 million.
Dealers noted low trading interests as many players are on Christmas holiday.

"Only some year-end U.S. dollar demand emerged, which was almost offset by exporters' U.S. dollar supply," said one dealer. Interest from exporters to sell U.S. dollars around the T$27.50 level remained high, she said.
